subject.title: feat: add Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should maintainers retire this dirty original draft in favor of the rebased successor, or repair this branch as the canonical landing path for the Computer Use manifest contract?
rationale: The contract is additive but public plugin API, and its metadata is intended to inform host decisions around Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions; automation cannot choose the permanent API shape or canonical branch while both PRs are open.

options.title: Use the rebased successor after fixes
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101564 as the canonical branch, complete generated-doc and security-boundary review there, and leave this original draft open only until maintainers explicitly retire it.

options.title: Repair this original branch
options.body: Ask the author to resolve conflicts against current main, regenerate `docs/docs_map.md`, and keep this PR as the landing path for the contract.

options.title: Pause the contract
options.body: Keep both draft branches parked until the macOS host binding model is settled enough to publish this plugin manifest API.

recommendation.title: Use the rebased successor after fixes
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101564 as the canonical branch, complete generated-doc and security-boundary review there, and leave this original draft open only until maintainers explicitly retire it.
